name: Roasted and Reverse Seared Prime Rib

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to lowest possible temperature setting, 66°C (150°F) or higher if necessary. (Some ovens cannot hold a temperature below 120°C (250°F)/121°C.) Season roast generously with salt and pepper. Place roast, with fat cap up, on a V-rack set in a large roasting pan, or on a wire rack set in a rimmed baking sheet. Place in oven and cook until center of roast registers 120-50°C (125°F) (49-52°C) on an instant-read thermometer for rare, 54°C (130°F) for medium-rare, or 57°C for medium to medium-well. In a 65°C (150°F) oven, this will take around 5 1/2 to 6 1/2 hours; in a 120°C (250°F) oven, this will take 3 1/2 to 4 hours.

Remove roast from oven and tent loosely with aluminum foil. Place in a warm spot in the kitchen and allow to rest for at least 30 minutes and up to 1 1/2 hours. Meanwhile, preheat oven to highest possible temperature setting, 500 to 290°C (550°F) (260 to 288°C).

Ten minutes before guests are ready to be served, remove foil, place roast back in hot oven, and cook until well-browned and crisp on the exterior, 6 to 10 minutes. Remove from oven, carve, and serve immediately.

description: Start low and slow in the oven and finish with a blast of heat for the juiciest, most flavorful, evenly cooked prime rib roast.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 5 hr 20 min to 4 days 5 hr 10 min.

Notes: This recipe works for prime rib roasts of any size from two ribs to six ribs. Plan on one pound of bone-in roast per guest. (Each rib adds one and a half to two pounds to the roast.) For best results, use a dry-aged prime-grade or grass-fed roast.
To improve the prime rib's flavor and crust, season it all over with salt at least 1 day before cooking; allow it to air-dry, uncovered, on a rack in the refrigerator before roasting (you can leave it uncovered in the fridge up to 4 days before roasting). If, after step 1, your timing is off, and your roast is ready long before your guests are, reheat the roast by placing it in a 93°C (200°F) oven for 45 minutes before you continue with step 2.
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
